auth.usage_instructions: Authentication management via Airtable PAT delegation. Use to login, logout, test credentials, or check auth status. CourseCraft delegates auth to the airtable CLI under the hood.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.

logout.usage_instructions: Clear stored Airtable credentials. Delegates to 'airtable auth logout'.

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. create.help: Create demo record(s) in Airtable linked to a clip. Supports two modes: 1. Single demo mode: Use optional fields to create one demo 2. Batch mode: Use --json or --file to create multiple demos The --clip-order is required and specifies the position of the demo within the clip, alongside slides which also have a clip order. In batch mode the per-demo JSON keys "name", "clip_order", "target_length", "demo_overview", "action_summary", "script", "execution_method", and "notes" set each demo's values. Every one of those keys except "name" falls back to the matching CLI option when the key is absent, so --clip-order, --target-length, --demo-overview, --action-summary, --script, --execution-method, and --notes act as per-demo defaults. --name is never a batch default: two demos in one clip cannot share a name.
create.usage_instructions: Create one or more demo records. Requires --clip/-c (clip record ID) and --clip-order/-o (position within clip). Single mode: optional --name/-n, --target-length/-l (FLOAT, e.g., 2.5), --action-summary/-a, --script/-s. Batch mode: use --json (inline JSON array) or --file (JSON file path). Demo environment facts are owned by the project-level demo-environment skill, not linked Airtable records.

update.help: Update a feedback record. Stamping a row Applied with a --remediation summary REQUIRES at least one --remediation-claim, and every claim is verified before anything is written: check:<dotted.check.id>              the id must be declared as an 'id' in a checks.json under the CourseCraft skills tree, and its contract must be reachable record:<recordId>:<Field>=<value>    the live record's field must equal the claimed value (trimmed strings) record:<recordId>:<Field>~=<text>    the live record's field must contain the claimed substring A claim that does not verify fails the command with exit 1 and writes NOTHING. There is no warn-and-continue path: an Applied stamp may not assert a check id or record value that does not exist.

create.help: Create slide record(s) in Airtable linked to a clip. Supports two modes: 1. Single slide mode: Use --template to create one slide 2. Batch mode: Use --json or --file to create multiple slides A slide is a duplicate only when its clip, template, AND clip order all match an existing slide, so one clip can hold several slides from the same template at different clip orders (two demos need two Demo Intro slides). In batch mode the per-slide JSON keys "template", "clip_order", "demo", "target_length", and "notes" set each slide's values; "clip_order", "demo", "target_length", and "notes" fall back to the matching CLI option when the key is absent.
create.usage_instructions: Create one or more slide records. Requires --clip/-c (clip record ID). Single mode: use --template/-t (template record ID), --target-length/-l (FLOAT, e.g., 0.5). Batch mode: use --json (inline JSON array) or --file (JSON file path).

voice-recordings.help: Generate slide and demo voice recordings

generate.help: Generate a voice recording for one slide or demo script.
generate.usage_instructions: Generate from exactly one Script record: --slide recXXX or --demo recXXX. Demo generation is transactional and supports only --output-format mp3_44100_128 (authoritative suffix .mp3). Production voice precedence is --voice-id, the Demo's current ElevenLabs Voice ID, then exactly one live voice labeled coursecraft_role=production; the chosen voice and --model-id are live-verified. Demo identity includes canonical normalized Script/source hash, voice, model, format, pronunciation dictionary ID/version, all tuning values, and validated output hash. It generates to a unique unregistered staging candidate, validates full decode/one audio stream/positive duration, canonical source hash, no cue leakage, whole-script Whisper recall, peak/clipping policy, and exact request identity, then promotes without overwriting the prior take. One CourseCraft write registers narration metadata plus Voice Recording Path and Dictation Recorded, followed by uncached readback; it never writes Recorded. Adjacent .narration.json metadata exposes authoritative source/output hashes and the derived-WAV adapter policy. Identical validated identity reuses without ElevenLabs spend; timeout or unknown write state is reconciled and automatic retry is blocked until state is known. Slide generation retains the legacy explicit --voice-id behavior.

preview.help: Preview normalized demo narration and validate Script cues/manifest anchors without mutation.
preview.usage_instructions: Run before automatic demo narration generation. This command is read-only: it reads the Demo Script and walkthrough manifest but makes no ElevenLabs call and performs no Airtable mutation. It requires one positive record Target Length (Min), enforces the same Target Length (Min) * 180 total-word budget as demo generation through CourseCraft's canonical Demo Script contract, and emits normalizedNarration, normalizedNarrationSha256, narrationBudget, cueValidation, and anchorValidation as JSON. Exit 0 with valid=true permits generation; a nonzero exit blocks paid generation until budget, cue, or manifest-anchor errors are corrected.

usage_instructions: Use for managing CourseCraft course content stored in Airtable. Manages a hierarchy of courses, modules, clips, demos, and slides. Commands follow the `coursecraft <group> <action>` pattern. Most list commands support --table/-t for formatted output, --filter/-f for field:op:value filtering, --properties/-p for field selection, and --limit/-l for pagination. Use --no-cache globally to bypass response cache. Before automatic demo narration generation, run voice-recordings preview --demo <recID>; it is read-only and validates normalized narration, SHA-256, cues, and manifest anchors. Use voice-recordings generate for optional recording-phase narration audio generation with ElevenLabs only after preview succeeds.
